units: SI unless stated; temperatures K in tables, degC in limits
frame: body: x forward (between arms 1 and 6), y left, z up; world: x east, z up; wind blows westward (negative x) at the tabulated speed

temperature_K.source: 40-64 km: Pioneer Venus 4-probe mean (PDS raw tables); outside: VIRA-like table via Wikipedia

speed_of_sound_m_s.source: ideal gas with NIST Cp of 96.5 % CO2 + 3.5 % N2

wind_west_mean_m_s.source: 40-64 km: PV DLBI, mean of the probes with a sample within +-0.5 km (2-4 probes; 4-probe interpolation is 0-2.4 m/s lower, R_audit_2026-11-04); outside: Landis anchors, linear [Y]

solar_array_overhead_W_m2.source: Landis & Haag 2013 Table 1 (29 % array), LSFR shape above 60 km

up_down_ratio.source: Pioneer Venus LSFR upward/downward flux (COMBINED channel)

vertical_gust_sigma.source: VEGA balloons at 53-54 km (sd 0.65-0.75), A_vega1985 note

vertical_gust_correlation.source: VEGA W_a autocorrelation: R(300 s)=0.78, R(600 s)=0.59-0.71, R(1200 s)=0.53-0.56, R(1800 s)=0.28 -> 1/e at ~1500 s (E_04). Sampling is 75.5 s, so periods < ~150 s are not resolved by this record. Tag in venus_turbulence_model.json: K from D. Lagrangian time; flying through the cells at airspeed V the effective time is 1/tau = 1/1500 s + V/5000 m (409 s at 8.9 m/s). [v0.7: was 80.0 in v0.6]

horizontal_gust_sigma.source: VEGA fluctuations up to 1-2 m/s x 1.5 (D-ag)

meridional_wind_max.source: PV DLBI |v| <= ~7.5 m/s at 45-62 km, typically 1-5 (A_counselman1980 note)

mass.source: aerokit.venus.sizing.close with hover +3.42 % (venus_budget_update.close_with_interaction) [v0.7: was 43.655232 in v0.6]

cg.source: component layout of the variant design.json [v0.7: was [-0.0, -0.0, 0.04] in v0.6]

inertia.source: point masses + rods from the variant design.json [v0.7: was [[33.194, -0.0, 0.0], [-0.0, 33.194, 0.0], [0.0, 0.0, 65.088]] in v0.6]

positions.source: arm radius x azimuth 30+60 i deg

polar_inertia.source: blade rods; aerokit.venus.sizing.close with hover +3.42 % (venus_budget_update.close_with_interaction) [v0.7: was 0.1708 in v0.6]

collective_hover.source: BEMT trim at 55 km; aerokit.venus.sizing.close with hover +3.42 % (venus_budget_update.close_with_interaction) [v0.7: was 7.044199 in v0.6]

curve_at_55km.source: BEMT (validated vs Knight & Hefner / Harrington, torque rms 6.3 %)
curve_at_55km.density_scaling: thrust and torque scale with density at fixed rpm and pitch (C_T, C_Q constant): multiply by rho(h)/rho(55 km)

heave_derivative.source: BEMT dT/dw at fixed rpm, pitch (whole vehicle); aerokit.venus.sizing.close with hover +3.42 % (venus_budget_update.close_with_interaction) [v0.7: was -31.783517 in v0.6]

vortex_ring_band.source: helicopter practice; thrust -20 % inside, unless airspeed > v_h

v_h_55km.source: momentum theory per rotor; aerokit.venus.sizing.close with hover +3.42 % (venus_budget_update.close_with_interaction) [v0.7: was 2.59062 in v0.6]

rpm_response_20pct.source: rotor inertia / spare torque; aerokit.venus.sizing.close with hover +3.42 % (venus_budget_update.close_with_interaction) [v0.7: was 0.30479 in v0.6]

battery_capacity.source: 0.5 h of 2219 W hover; aerokit.venus.sizing.close with hover +3.42 % (venus_budget_update.close_with_interaction) [v0.7: was 1044.139461 in v0.6]

hover_electric_55km.source: BEMT + hover interaction +3.42 % (guc_egrisi.json, extrapolated to 0.04 D [Y]) [v0.7: was 2088.279178 in v0.6]

loiter_electric_55km.source: aerokit level power x nominal interaction ratio (guc_egrisi.json) [v0.7: was 1336.529094 in v0.6]

loiter_airspeed.source: minimum-power speed with nominal interaction [v0.7: was 7.8 in v0.6]

limits.name: advance ratio for the momentum model
limits.note: station keeping at the wind speed would need mu 0.7-1.2

limits.name: max airspeed
limits.source: level-flight speed whose shaft power stays below 1.6^1.5 x hover shaft power, with nominal interaction (ratio held at its 20 m/s value above the last trimmed curve point)

limits.name: acid exposure tested (FEP)
limits.source: manufacturer test, conc. H2SO4 at 120 degC

limits.name: science dive floor
limits.source: battery 57.5 degC peak after the 5 min hold at 52 km at 1.5 m/s down (venus_budget_update.fly) [v0.7: was 51.0 in v0.6]

limits.name: dive abort battery temperature
limits.source: doc 25 §0: 50 -> 52 degC, the 5 min hold at 52 km at 1.5 m/s needs it; venus_budget_update.Profile [v0.7: new row]

limits.name: release sun height, minimum cos z
limits.source: doc 25 §0: 52.7 A at cos z 0.68 against the 2C limit; simulator at 43.66 kg, not rerun at 44.63 kg [v0.7: new row]

limits.name: release rotor speed, maximum
limits.source: doc 25 §5.2: 1.30 x hover rpm, back-EMF cap [v0.7: new row]

limits.name: descent to cruise
limits.source: doc 25 §5.2: outside the vortex-ring band; venus_budget_update.Profile [v0.7: new row]

limits.name: battery discharge current 2C
limits.source: 14S8P pack (venus_budget_update.pack at 1109 Wh); 2C is an aerokit input, not a measured limit [v0.7: new row]

failure_modes.name: motor out
failure_modes.trigger: one motor fails (2 % per deployment in the Monte Carlo [Y])
failure_modes.effect: thrust margin 1.6 -> 1.6 x 5/6 = 1.33; yaw trim by the opposite pair

failure_modes.name: downdraft
failure_modes.recovery: ride it within 52-58 km, climb back (0.4 kWh)

failure_modes.name: sun too low
failure_modes.effect: battery drains, up to ~376 W before the sunset dive
failure_modes.recovery: ~3.5 h on battery, then sunset dive

failure_modes.name: night
failure_modes.effect: 0 W solar; 1.11 kWh vs ~125 kWh needed (loiter power x half the 154 h air-mass day)
failure_modes.recovery: none for a pure rotorcraft (helium hybrid only)
